headline: Magic-language input UI, 655 NPC dialog rows, cooking narration, recipe menus, song-title audit
summary: v2.4 is a content release built on top of every v2.32 fix. Major translation surfaces added: magic-language input UI (362 tiles), 655 NPC dialog rows across 46 message files, cooking narration during recipe creation, recipe-menu labels (11), and a song-title JP-faithfulness audit of all 96 entries.
